event.title: USC Roski MA Curatorial Practices: the very substance of ourselves
event.description:
The USC Roski MA '27 Cohort in Curatorial Practices and the Public Sphere presents the very substance of ourselves. The exhibition traces the connective tissues that bridge our physical bodies and interiorities with the constructed and natural landscapes that we inhabit. Grounded in posthumanist philosopher Stacy Alaimo’s concept of transcorporeality, the exhibition theorizes human bodies as deeply enmeshed in an active and lively world of matter, rather than sole actors in an inert environment. The included artists explore many forms of transformation—from invasive to intangible—as they relate to physicality, embodiment, memory and identity across time and space. The very substance of ourselves invites viewers to consider how the self is continually reshaped through contact with others, extending outward and merging with the world around us.

 

Featuring work by... Ophelia Arc • Isabel Avila • Brenda Barrios • Jay Carlon • Alexandra Carter • Tracy L. Chandler • courtney coles • Olivia Rae Harris • Shana Hoehn • Maria Maea • Yong Soon Min • Debra Scacco

MA 2027 Curatorial Team... Meg Burns • Sam Garduño Marin • Anabelle Gunderson • Eunice Han • Courtney King • Jiwon Lee • Lexi Myrie • Jialiang Wang

event.title: Lead On! 2026: 6th Annual Leadership Conference for Mid-level Communication Executives
event.description:
Lead On! 2026 the 6th annual Leadership conference for mid-level communication executives.

You've mastered the middle. Now it's time to own the room.

Join us October 15–16 for Lead On! 2026, the USC Annenberg Center for Public Relations' premier leadership forum designed to give PR and communications managers the tools, speakers, and strategies to take that next bold step in their leadership journey.

 

Over two immersive days, you will engage in hands-on workshops, candid conversations, and meaningful connections that sharpen your leadership instincts, strengthen your communication strategy, deepen your negotiation skills, and build the confidence to lead at the highest level.
The next chapter of your career starts here.

A Conference Built for Impact: With only 40 participants, Lead On! is one of the most intimate leadership forums of its kind. This intentionally small setting creates the space for deeper learning, real mentorship, and the kind of networking that actually moves careers forward.

 

Registration includes meals, snack and beverage service throughout the conference. Discounted hotel accommodations are available at the USC Hotel. Contact usccpr@usc.edu for codes and additional information.

RSVP here

event.title: Forbidden Pages: Past and Present
event.description: Forbidden Pages: Past and Present features books, periodicals, photographs, and other materials from the USC Libraries’ collections that tell the story of censorship and resistance over the centuries. Among them are a charred fragment of Lion Feuchtwanger’s novel Jud Süß, pulled from the embers of the Nazi book burnings in Berlin in 1933; a 1761 edition of the Catholic Church’s Index Librorum Prohibitorum, its centuries-long list of prohibited books; and a 1954 issue of ONE Magazine which the Los Angeles postmaster declared obscene and refused to mail. Visitors will also encounter works by authors ranging from John Milton, Harriet Beecher Stowe, and Mark Twain to Toni Morrison, Judy Blume, and Salman Rushdie. The exhibition opens on Monday, October 5, in Doheny Memorial Library’s first-floor and runs through the fall semester. Presented in partnership with the USC Open Dialogue Project.

event.title: Investiture of President Beong-Soo Kim
event.address: Between Doheny Library and Bovard Auditorium, Los Angeles, CA 90089
event.description:
On Friday, Oct. 16, 2026, the USC community will gather for the investiture of Beong-Soo Kim as the university’s 13th president. This historic academic ceremony marks the formal installation of President Kim and brings together students, faculty, staff, alumni, and the community to celebrate a new chapter in USC’s history.

 

Investiture Ceremony
This historic academic ceremony marks the formal installation of President Kim.
Friday, October 16, 2026
9:30 A.M.
Alumni Park

 

Trojan Family Celebration
Join fellow USC students, faculty, staff and members of the community for a campus-wide celebration honoring the investiture of President Beong-Soo Kim. Enjoy live performances, creative arts experiences, interactive games, food and plenty of Trojan fun.
Friday, October 16, 2026
1:30 P.M. - 3:30 P.M.
McCarthy Quad 

 

Kindly RSVP by Wednesday, Oct. 7 online at usc.edu/esvp (code: INVESTITURE). For more information, visit president.usc.edu/investiture.
